metadata.remarks: Secure Server is a composite pattern expressing the institutional position that servers and workloads are acceptable execution environments for institutional services. This assertion is valid only when server identity and ownership are established, platform integrity is verifiable, configuration and baseline state are controlled, vulnerability exposure is understood, runtime behavior is actively protected, and activity is observable and responsive. This pattern introduces no independent controls.

components.title: Server Core

components.title: Server Configuration and Baseline

components.title: Server Patch and Vulnerability Posture

components.title: Server Runtime Protection
components.description: Active protection of servers and workloads during execution.

components.title: Server Monitoring and Response
components.description: Visibility, detection, and coordinated response for server and workload activity.
